courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
related.transfer: 可遷移「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」與「水汽相位起伏與輻射計校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity" and "Water-vapour phase fluctuations and radiometric correction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Radio-telescope low-noise receivers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦5000 公尺高原上 66 座天線的毫米波干涉成像：大氣、天線面形、SIS 接收機、水汽相位校正與相關器；電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機則以從饋源到低溫 HEMT／SIS 前端的雜訊溫度、Friis 級聯、校正與穩定度工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on millimetre interferometric imaging with 66 antennas at 5000 m: atmosphere, antenna surfaces, SIS receivers, water-vapour phase correction and the correlator; Radio-telescope low-noise receivers centres on noise temperature, Friis cascade, calibration and stability engineering from feed horn to cryogenic HEMT/SIS front end, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「查南托高原大氣視窗」與「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「增益漲落、1/f 雜訊與 Allan 時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Chajnantor atmospheric window” and “System noise temperature Tsys”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Radio-telescope low-noise receivers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gain fluctuations, 1/f noise and the Allan time", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity" and "Water-vapour phase fluctuations and radiometric correction" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Radio-array correlators must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦5000 公尺高原上 66 座天線的毫米波干涉成像：大氣、天線面形、SIS 接收機、水汽相位校正與相關器；電波陣列相關器則以從取樣量化、延遲補償到 FX 乘加與校正的數位相關器工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on millimetre interferometric imaging with 66 antennas at 5000 m: atmosphere, antenna surfaces, SIS receivers, water-vapour phase correction and the correlator; Radio-array correlators centres on digital correlator engineering from sampling and quantisation through delay compensation to FX multiply-accumulate and calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

把本課算例的一個假設移到電波陣列相關器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Chajnantor atmospheric window” and “Visibility and the (u,v) plane”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Radio-array correlators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列
history.text: ALMA 由歐洲南方天文台（ESO）、美國國家科學基金會（經 NRAO）與日本國立天文台（NAOJ，含台灣與韓國的參與）合作，在智利北部查南托高原建造，2003 年動工、2011 年以部分天線開始早期科學觀測、2013 年 3 月落成；12 m 天線由北美與歐洲兩家承包團隊製造，日本負責 Morita 緊湊陣列的 16 座天線，台灣中研院天文所參與前端整合與 Band 1 接收機研製。此後陣列持續更新，包括規劃中的寬頻靈敏度升級。本課只重建公開的工程原理，不涉及任何承包商的專有設計。
history.textEn: ALMA was built on the Chajnantor plateau of northern Chile by ESO, the US National Science Foundation through NRAO, and the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan (NAOJ, with Taiwan and Korea participating): construction began in 2003, early science started in 2011 with a partial array, and the observatory was inaugurated in March 2013. The 12 m antennas came from North American and European contractor teams, Japan delivered the 16 antennas of the Morita compact array, and Taiwan's ASIAA contributed front-end integration and Band 1 receiver development. The array keeps evolving, including the planned wideband sensitivity upgrade. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles, not any contractor's proprietary design.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」到「天線整合、重組與陣列驗收」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity" through "Antenna integration, reconfiguration and array acceptance" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
